name: Confederate States
facts: A battle flag, never the national flag
Eleven states of the US South

flag.description: A square red field with a blue saltire edged in white, bearing thirteen white five-pointed stars.
flag.symbolism: The thirteen stars stood for the eleven seceded states plus Kentucky and Missouri, which the Confederacy also claimed.

hook: The Confederate battle flag, a starred blue X on red, was carried by the armies of the states that seceded to preserve slavery; it was never the Confederacy's national flag.
trivia: The Confederacy had three successive national flags; the first, the "Stars and Bars", had red and white stripes and a blue canton with a circle of stars.
The battle flag was revived in the 20th century, notably by opponents of the civil rights movement, and is widely seen today as a symbol of slavery and racism.
